test.summary: SPM – OKR – Automated updates visibility and behavior when toggle is ON
test.description:
h3. Description

This test verifies automated updates visibility and behavior in OKR details when automated updates toggle is enabled.

Covered areas:

* Details page
* Status changes tab
* Activity tab
* Public API updates
* AUTO/OKRobot updates
* Toggle: {{Show automated updates}}
* Info panel ({{Last updated}})

Validation scope:

* Verifying API updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying AUTO updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying API updates are marked with {{API}} label
* Verifying {{Last updated}} section displays latest API update correctly
* Verifying automated updates are hidden after disabling the toggle

steps.action:
*Preconditions:*

Objective and Key Result are created and linked to the box

steps.data: boxName: TC-6252 SPM – OKR – Automated updates visibility and behavior when toggle is ON
steps.result: Objective and Key result are displayed in Overview

steps.action: Open Objective in Detail page and navigate to status changes
steps.result:
Objective detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

"Objective created" status update is displayed in the Status changes section.

steps.action: Open Key result in Detail page and navigate to status changes
steps.result:
Key result detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

"Key result created" status update is displayed in the Status changes section.

steps.action:
Using Postman or Swagger, make an API call to update the KR status (use the API authentication token generated in OKR Settings on the tested instance).

Make sure you use OKR PROD:
[https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com|https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com]

Making requests to STAGING may require additional database changes for your staging instance from the Delta team. Otherwise, you may receive the following response:

{{403 - API interaction with uninstalled app is not allowed}}
steps.data:
Request: 

{noformat}curl -X 'POST' \
  'https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com/api/v2/api-update/keyResults' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H 'API-Token: 5f62be4d-1e92-4041-91ca-c405ab5e3a9d' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "keyResultId": "6a103161e127ea09da42cc67",
  "status": "AT RISK",
  "newValue": 13500.5,
  "description": "Reduction in ship hull output is caused by Unobtainium supply disruptions."
}'{noformat}
steps.result: API request is completed successfully and {{201 Created}} response status is returned.
API update is displayed in the Status changes section with *API* label, correct status, current value, progress and update description. Show automated updates toggle is enabled.

Info section is displayed correctly. *Last updated* field shows the latest API update date together with the *API label.*

!xray-attachment://9e70293d-7033-494f-b73e-3a7a6fbfbdda|width=66.66666666666666%!

steps.action: Click Update button and change status to "ON TRACK"
steps.result: Status is changed to ON TRACK

*Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

Status update is displayed correctly in the Status changes section. API label is not displayed for manual update

Last updated field is visible under Status and displayed last updated date (DD/MM/YY) 
API label is not displayed for manual update

steps.action: Navigate to Status changes and disable *Show automated updates*
steps.result: Show automated updates toggle is disabled. Only manual updates are displayed in the Status changes section. AUTO updates are hidden.

Description:
h3. Description

This test verifies automated updates visibility and behavior in OKR details when automated updates toggle is enabled.

Covered areas:

* Details page
* Status changes tab
* Activity tab
* Public API updates
* AUTO/OKRobot updates
* Toggle: {{Show automated updates}}
* Info panel ({{Last updated}})

Validation scope:

* Verifying API updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying AUTO updates are visible when toggle is ON
* Verifying API updates are marked with {{API}} label
* Verifying {{Last updated}} section displays latest API update correctly
* Verifying automated updates are hidden after disabling the toggle

Steps:
1. *Preconditions:*

Objective and Key Result are created and linked to the box
   Data: * Objective 1
* Key result 1
   Expected: 
2. Open OKR Overview of boxName
   Data: boxName: TC-6252 SPM – OKR – Automated updates visibility and behavior when toggle is ON
   Expected: Objective and Key result are displayed in Overview
3. Open Objective in Detail page and navigate to status changes
   Expected: Objective detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

"Objective created" status update is displayed in the Status changes section.
4. Open Key result in Detail page and navigate to status changes
   Expected: Key result detail page is opened. *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

"Key result created" status update is displayed in the Status changes section.
5. Using Postman or Swagger, make an API call to update the KR status (use the API authentication token generated in OKR Settings on the tested instance).

Make sure you use OKR PROD:
[https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com|https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com]

Making requests to STAGING may require additional database changes for your staging instance from the Delta team. Otherwise, you may receive the following response:

{{403 - API interaction with uninstalled app is not allowed}}
   Data: Request: 

{noformat}curl -X 'POST' \
  'https://okr-ppm-prod.appfire.com/api/v2/api-update/keyResults' \
  -H 'accept: application/json' \
  -H 'API-Token: 5f62be4d-1e92-4041-91ca-c405ab5e3a9d' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{
  "keyResultId": "6a103161e127ea09da42cc67",
  "status": "AT RISK",
  "newValue": 13500.5,
  "description": "Reduction in ship hull output is caused by Unobtainium supply disruptions."
}'{noformat}
   Expected: API request is completed successfully and {{201 Created}} response status is returned.
6. Navigate to Status changes
   Expected: API update is displayed in the Status changes section with *API* label, correct status, current value, progress and update description. Show automated updates toggle is enabled.
7. Navigate to Info section
   Expected: Info section is displayed correctly. *Last updated* field shows the latest API update date together with the *API label.*

!xray-attachment://9e70293d-7033-494f-b73e-3a7a6fbfbdda|width=66.66666666666666%!
8. Click Update button and change status to "ON TRACK"
   Expected: Status is changed to ON TRACK
9. Navigate to Status changes
   Expected: *Show automated updates* toggle is visible and enabled.

Status update is displayed correctly in the Status changes section. API label is not displayed for manual update
10. Navigate to Info section
   Expected: Last updated field is visible under Status and displayed last updated date (DD/MM/YY) 
API label is not displayed for manual update
11. Navigate to Status changes and disable *Show automated updates*
   Expected: Show automated updates toggle is disabled. Only manual updates are displayed in the Status changes section. AUTO updates are hidden.
